## What pulling this in gets you

Declaring `carbon-adk.dev.game.unity` in a project brings **this pack and everything above it**,
fetched lazily into `.carbon/sources/` and copied into your agent's directory.

It never brings anything *below* it, and never anything *beside* it. Ancestry
points up only — which is also why an ungranted module is unreachable rather
than merely forbidden.

```bash
# in your carbon.project.yaml
#   requires:    carbon-adk.dev.game.unity: ">=0.1.0"
#   submodules:  carbon-adk.dev.game.unity: is-a
#   sources:     carbon-adk.dev.game.unity: "git+https://github.com/mpuls-midknightdev/carbon-adk.dev.game.unity"

carbon-synapse --tool claude
```
